fingerprint_method.description: Sort regular files by project-relative path, hash each file with sha256sum, concatenate the records, and hash the resulting manifest. The declared src scope includes the existing tracked egg-info files for continuity with the prior Phase 2 fingerprint.
fingerprint_method.evidence_review_note: The pre-closeout evidence fingerprint includes the existing readiness.json; the later review manifest uses an explicit self-excluding immutable payload closure.
